mapper.select: SELECT USER_SN, USER_SE_CD, AUTHRT_CD, USER_ID, ENPSWD, USER_NM, MBL_TELNO, EML_ADDR, ZIP, ADDR, DTL_ADDR, CO_NM, DEPT_NM, JBGD_NM, MMPL_STTS_CD, LAST_CNTN_DT, REG_DT, RGTR, MDFCN_DT, MDTR, DEL_DT, DELTR FROM USER_MST WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn}

SELECT USER_SN, USER_SE_CD, AUTHRT_CD, USER_ID, ENPSWD, USER_NM, MBL_TELNO, EML_ADDR, ZIP, ADDR, DTL_ADDR, CO_NM, DEPT_NM, JBGD_NM, MMPL_STTS_CD, LAST_CNTN_DT, REG_DT, RGTR, MDFCN_DT, MDTR, DEL_DT, DELTR FROM USER_MST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_DT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_MST ( USER_SE_CD, AUTHRT_CD, USER_ID, ENPSWD, USER_NM, MBL_TELNO, EML_ADDR, ZIP, ADDR, DTL_ADDR, CO_NM, DEPT_NM, JBGD_NM, MMPL_STTS_CD, RGTR ) VALUES ( #{userSeCd}, #{authrtCd}, #{userId}, #{enpswd}, #{userNm}, #{mblTelno}, #{emlAddr}, #{zip}, #{addr}, #{dtlAddr}, #{coNm}, #{deptNm}, #{jbgdNm}, #{mmplSttsCd}, #{rgtr} )
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_MST SET USER_ID = CONCAT('DEL_', USER_SN), ENPSWD = '', USER_NM = '', MBL_TELNO = NULL, EML_ADDR = NULL, ZIP = NULL, ADDR = NULL, DTL_ADDR = NULL, CO_NM = NULL, DEPT_NM = NULL, JBGD_NM = NULL, MMPL_STTS_CD = 'N', DEL_DT = NOW(), DELTR = #{deltr} WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL
